# FurnitureAI Copilot instructions

Before proposing or applying repository changes, read `/AGENTS.md` and follow it.

Use GitHub issue #66 as the live coordination board. Confirm the latest `main` SHA, active AI leases, open PRs, and file overlap before editing. Register an `AI-LEASE` before coding and an `AI-RELEASE` when finished.

Never bypass the coordination CI guard or silently overlap another non-draft PR.
